import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = "notes"


def read_public(path: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of the file at request path `path` inside the
    directory `notes` (relative to the working directory), or "".

    Paths that wander and return inside `notes` (e.g. "sub/../a.txt") are
    allowed. Any path that leaves `notes` (e.g. "..", "sub/../../x"), any
    absolute path, and any name that resolves (including through symlinks)
    to a file outside `notes` yields "". Missing, unreadable, non-file
    targets and malformed names (e.g. containing a NUL byte) yield "".
    The path is untrusted input and must never raise.
    """
    if "\x00" in path:
        return ""
    try:
        requested = Path(path)
        # Absolute names (including drive/root anchored ones) are never allowed;
        # joining them would otherwise discard the notes prefix.
        if (
            os.path.isabs(path)
            or path.startswith(("/", "\\"))
            or requested.is_absolute()
            or requested.anchor != ""
            or requested.drive != ""
        ):
            return ""
        root = Path(ROOT).resolve()
        target = (root / requested).resolve()
        if target == root or not target.is_relative_to(root):
            return ""
        if not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, UnicodeError):
        return ""


@pytest.fixture
def work(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    base = tmp_path / "work"
    (base / ROOT / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (base / ROOT / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    (base / ROOT / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("nested", encoding="utf-8")
    (base / "secret.txt").write_text("TOP SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "outside.txt").write_text("OUTSIDE", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(base)
    return base


def test_reads_plain_file(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("a.txt") == "hello"


def test_reads_nested_file(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("sub/b.txt") == "nested"


def test_wander_and_return_is_fine(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("sub/../a.txt") == "hello"
    assert read_public("./sub/./b.txt") == "nested"
    assert read_public("sub/../sub/b.txt") == "nested"


def test_missing_file(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("nope.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/nope.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("nodir/a.txt") == ""


def test_directory_and_empty(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("sub") == ""
    assert read_public("") == ""
    assert read_public(".") == ""


def test_dotdot_escape(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("..") == ""
    assert read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/../../../outside.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("../../outside.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_paths(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public(str(work / "secret.txt")) == ""
    assert read_public(str(work / ROOT / "a.txt")) == ""
    assert read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
    assert read_public("//etc/passwd") == ""


def test_nul_byte(work: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("a.txt\x00.png") == ""
    assert read_public("\x00") == ""


def test_symlink_escape(work: Path) -> None:
    link = work / ROOT / "link.txt"
    try:
        os.symlink(work / "secret.txt", link)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
    assert read_public("link.txt") == ""


def test_symlinked_dir_escape(work: Path) -> None:
    link = work / ROOT / "outdir"
    try:
        os.symlink(work, link, target_is_directory=True)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
    assert read_public("outdir/secret.txt") == ""


def test_symlink_inside_notes_ok(work: Path) -> None:
    link = work / ROOT / "alias.txt"
    try:
        os.symlink(work / ROOT / "a.txt", link)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
    assert read_public("alias.txt") == "hello"


def test_sibling_prefix_directory(work: Path) -> None:
    sibling = work / "notes2"
    sibling.mkdir()
    (sibling / "x.txt").write_text("sibling", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public("../notes2/x.txt") == ""
